newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DEGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DEGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 28.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi petrochemical company 'Sadaf' is to set up a new petrochemical plant in Jubail with a production capacity of 520,000 metric tones a year.
- Dubai imported $4 billion worth of gold in 1996. Around 70 percent of it was re-exported.
- A Kuwaiti parliamentary committee demanded the trial of ex-officials in the Kuwaiti Investment office.
- Saudi's Savola Co posted 28 million riyals net profit in the first three months of 1997.
- Iran's industry minister held talks with officials in Jordan to discuss investment opportunities.
